description: Legion commander, pos6 eco/tech, first medmex (legmext15) online

target.description: First medmex (legmext15) completes and comes online

detect_live.note: legmex→medmex upgrades income by ~2.28 m/s net; threshold 1.8 gives margin for ARM/Legion income variation

branch_point.description: Worker 1 (first factory-produced legck) has finished building both mex 6 and mex 7

detect_live.note: live server nMex reaches 7 when worker1 finishes mex 7

wind-in-place.description: After mex 6+7, worker 1 builds winds in place — trickle wind as a separate build queue from the main commander chain
wind-in-place.projected_note: Serial simulation (project.mjs) shows 280s because wind income arrives CONCURRENTLY with medmex build in real game — actual timing will be faster. The 274s mex-stall figure is cumulative from game start, not medmex-specific.

return-to-com.description: After mex 6+7, worker 1 walks back to commander — adds ~80 BP to build pool for medmex
return-to-com.projected_note: Projection uses com-only build (500 BP). Worker1 assist adds 580 BP total (300 com + 200 turret + 80 worker1), shortening build time. Actual timing will be faster. Worker1 walk from mex7 (~600 elmos) ≈ 16s at 36 e/s.

notes: Wind condition strongly affects the wind-in-place path: more wind = faster energy fill = less medmex stall. Return-to-com is more stable. Neither branch advantage is captured by project.mjs's serial model — real-game samples determine the winner.

_unit_calibration.leg_medmex_income: projected as +ARM_mex (1.8 m/s); actual is ΔM ≈+2.28 m/s net over replaced legmex. Correct via samples.
_unit_calibration.mex_stall_note: High mex stall (150s+) during early game is expected — high-priority builds starve mex upkeep (3 E/s each). Not a planning error; it represents real income lost to energy constraints. Queue early mexes LOW priority to eliminate it.
